## Split the session digest narrative into structured output: synthesize_narrative… — 2026-07-29 (parent 31687b714bf8)

`synthesize_narrative` now returns a `SessionNarrative` pydantic model instead of a plain string, with three fields:

- `one_liner` – plain-text skim line rendered bold in markdown
- `body` – ≤120-word narrative paragraph
- `conflicts` – list of intent-vs-diff discrepancy sentences, each rendered as a `> **Intent vs. diff:**` blockquote

`SessionNarrative.as_markdown()` is the single formatting point consumed by both `_run_digest_write` (via `render_digest_section`) and `diff_cmd` (via `Markdown()`). `_NARRATIVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` was rewritten to match the three-field schema, moving conflict observations out of body prose into the dedicated `conflicts` field. `synthesize_narrative` switches from `run_text` to `client.run(SessionNarrative, ...)` with a bare-string coercion fallback for legacy clients. Two new tests cover `test_session_narrative_as_markdown_formatting` and the updated `test_synthesize_narrative_uses_cache_prefix`.
